stories.title: A541 closed at Afonwen near Mold after collision
stories.summary: The A541 at Afonwen, near Mold, has been closed after a road traffic collision. North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team said emergency services were in attendance and a road closure was in place. stories.title: Two arrested in Flintshire overnight over suspected cooking oil theft
stories.summary: Two people were arrested in south Flintshire overnight on suspicion of stealing cooking oil, police have said. stories.summary: DVSA officers were told to stop using a roadside spot on the A494 at Aston Hill to wait for lorries, after the Welsh Government said it could find no record that they had ever been allowed to.
